findings.title: CVE-2026-20223 Cisco Secure Workload Unauthenticated Cross-Tenant Site-Admin RCE (CVSS 10.0)
findings.affected_technology: Cisco Secure Workload Cluster Software (SaaS + on-prem) — internal REST API
findings.summary: Weak validation and authentication on internal REST APIs lets remote unauthenticated attackers cross tenant boundaries and gain Site Admin privileges; vendor-discovered, no public ITW yet, fixed in 3.10.8.3 / 4.0.3.17, SaaS patched cloud-side.

findings.title: Microsoft Defender Zero-Days CVE-2026-41091 LPE + CVE-2026-45498 DoS Actively Exploited + KEV-Added 2026-05-20
findings.affected_technology: Microsoft Defender Antimalware Platform + Malware Protection Engine on all Windows versions
findings.summary: Paired Defender DoS + LPE actively exploited together as a blind-the-EDR-then-escalate post-exploit primitive; CISA KEV addition 2026-05-20 with 2026-06-03 federal deadline; fixed in Engine 1.1.26040.8+ and Platform 4.18.26040.7+.

findings.title: CVE-2026-46333 ssh-keysign-pwn Promoted — CVE Assigned, Multi-Distro Patches, Two Public Exploits, Industry-Framed as 4th Linux Kernel CVE in 3 Weeks
findings.affected_technology: Linux kernel __ptrace_may_access() race window introduced November 2016 — every major distro
findings.summary: Promoted from 2026-05-16 noted: CVE now assigned, upstream patch in mainline 2026-05-14, AlmaLinux/Ubuntu/Red Hat/CloudLinux/Debian/Fedora advisories shipped, two public exploits read /etc/shadow and SSH host keys; mitigate via Yama ptrace_scope=2 or 3 if unpatched.

findings.title: CVE-2026-45695 Kopia Backup Daemon SSH ProxyCommand Pre-Auth RCE (CVSS 9.8)
findings.affected_technology: Kopia self-hosted backup software (Go, HTTP server) versions ≤ 0.22.3
findings.summary: When started with --without-password, /api/v1/repo/exists accepts unauth requests; externalSSH SFTP backend splits attacker-supplied args on spaces and passes to exec.CommandContext, so -oProxyCommand=<cmd> yields RCE on a single unauth HTTP request; fixed in 0.23.0.

findings.title: Showboat Linux Malware — China-Aligned Calypso Cluster Persistent Middle East / Asia-Pacific Telecom Implant Since 2022
findings.affected_technology: Compromised Linux servers at Middle East and Asia-Pacific telecommunications providers and ISPs
findings.summary: Modular Linux post-exploit framework (remote shell + file transfer + SOCKS5 proxy) attributed to China-aligned Calypso (Bronze Medley / Red Lamassu) with C2 correlating to Chengdu IP space; victims include Afghanistan ISP and Azerbaijan target; long-dwell telecom espionage pattern.
